struct.name: MIG_DIFF_THRESH
struct.doc: Bit 63 is the valid bit: set when the kernel arms the threshold, cleared to disarm it while a candidate is handled. See MIG_DIFF_THRESH_VALID_BIT.

struct.name: MIG_VALUE_THRESH
struct.doc: Bit 63 is the valid bit, set to arm and cleared to disarm. See MIG_VALUE_THRESH_VALID_BIT.

struct.name: MIG_CANDIDATE
struct.doc: Read-to-clear alias of the candidate register. The kernel reads it in a loop until the valid bit (bit 63) is clear. The public Linux hub header calls 0x40 the candidate register and 0x48 its read-to-clear alias. The kernel reads only 0x48, so this is that alias; that a read consumes the candidate is inferred from the name and the loop. Nothing accesses 0x40. See MIG_CANDIDATE_VALID_BIT.
